entries.title: Psalms 103:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, [bless] his holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 103:2
segments: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

entries.title: Psalms 103:3
segments: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

entries.title: Psalms 103:4
segments: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good [things; so that] thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

entries.title: Psalms 103:6
segments: ¶The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

entries.title: Psalms 103:7
segments: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 103:8
segments: The LORD [is] merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. {plentious...: Heb. great in mercy}

entries.title: Psalms 103:9
segments: He will not always chide: neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 103:10
segments: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 103:11
segments: For as the heaven is high above the earth, [so] great is his mercy toward them that fear him. {as...: Heb. according to the height of the heaven}

words.text: him. {as...: Heb. according to the height of the heaven}

entries.title: Psalms 103:12
segments: As far as the east is from the west, [so] far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

entries.title: Psalms 103:13
segments: Like as a father pitieth [his] children, [so] the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

entries.title: Psalms 103:14
segments: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we [are] dust.

entries.title: Psalms 103:15
segments: [As for] man, his days [are] as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

entries.title: Psalms 103:16
segments: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more. {it is...: Heb. it is not}

words.text: it, and it is gone; and the place
it no more. {it is...: Heb. it is not}

entries.title: Psalms 103:17
segments: But the mercy of the LORD [is] from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

entries.title: Psalms 103:18
segments: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

entries.title: Psalms 103:19
segments: ¶The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

entries.title: Psalms 103:20
segments: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. {that excel...: Heb. mighty in strength}

entries.title: Psalms 103:21
segments: Bless ye the LORD, all [ye] his hosts; [ye] ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

entries.title: Psalms 103:22
segments: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
